images.title: Shikha and Sonu with two tapes
images.purpose: Show the hook story before any unit is explained: two friends at the weaving centre, one with a tape in centimetres and one with a tape in metres, and a folded sari between them. No number is written.
images.composition: A long table across the middle with a folded sari on it, one person at each end holding one end of a tape.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. CENTRE: one long flat table, a rounded rectangle top 1000 px wide and 40 px high (x 228 to 1228, y 470 to 510) filled amber #E69F00, with exactly 2 legs, each a rectangle 30 by 150 px (x 268 to 298 and x 1158 to 1188, y 510 to 660). ON THE TABLE: exactly 1 folded sari, a flat rounded rectangle 460 px wide and 70 px high (x 498 to 958, y 400 to 470) filled reddish purple #CC79A7 with exactly 3 thin dark horizontal stripes. LEFT: exactly 1 person, a flat figure with a head circle 80 px across (centre x 300, y 250) and a rounded body 100 by 170 px below it (y 290 to 460) filled teal #0072B2, one arm stretched right holding the left end of a tape. RIGHT: exactly 1 person, the same shape, centre x 1156, body filled green #009E73, one arm stretched left holding the right end of a second tape. TAPES: exactly 2 tapes, each a thin flat yellow rectangle 360 by 24 px with 12 evenly spaced short dark tick marks and no digits: the left tape (x 330 to 690, y 440 to 464) has the caption cm tape under it at y 500; the right tape (x 766 to 1126, y 440 to 464) has the caption m tape under it at y 500, both captions 36 px. In all: 2 people, 2 tapes, 1 sari, 1 table. No digit, no number, no unit value anywhere. All shapes are flat fills with thin dark #2B2B2B outlines (3 px), no shadows and no gradients; all text is dark #1F2937 sans-serif. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered

a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number

images.takeaway: Two friends can measure the same sari with two different tapes.
images.description: Two friends at a weaving table with a folded sari, one with a tape marked in centimetres and one with a tape marked in metres.
images.context: Concept image for the hook, Shikha and Sonu at the Weaving Centre. It follows the story in your maths book (saris and stoles measured in the village weaving centre) and gives no number and no answer.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student say what the two tapes might read. Do not say that 1 m is 100 cm here. The slip to watch: thinking that a longer tape always means a bigger number.
